primary_scope: Untreated primary PDAC, malignant vs nonmalignant epithelium, conditional on trustworthy cell labels and sample design
secondary_scope: Treated and metastatic strata kept separate; basal/classical comparisons only if corresponding labels are available and verified
expression: GEO raw counts; log1p(10000*LYPLA1_count/total_UMI) without imputation
identity_rule: No automatic promotion of epithelial/ductal labels to malignant. Original Werba labels and Loveless atlas reannotation must be distinguished.
planned_donor_inference: Same-author-donor pairs, each group >=20 selected-population cells and >=5 paired donors; paired mean expression and detection proportion contrasts; exact sign permutations when <=20 pairs
multiple_testing: Lock complete contrasts and BH families after label/design review and before differential testing; no differential testing in preparation batch
residency: All matrices, cell-level and donor-level measurements stay server165. Export only aggregate validation.
note: Atlas is a potential annotation source, not an independent cohort. Eligibility and author139446-cell population not yet reproduced.
